data [required]

[object]

List of AWS cloud authentication intake mappings.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes for AWS cloud authentication intake mapping response.

arn_pattern [required]

string

AWS caller ARN pattern allowed to authenticate for telemetry submission. ARN syntax and AWS integration membership are validated by the server. For an assumed role, use the STS assumed-role ARN with a trailing /* wildcard to match its sessions.

par_enrollment_enabled

boolean

Whether the mapping allows Private Action Runner enrollment. This attribute may be omitted when enrollment is disabled. Enrollment permission is managed separately from the ARN pattern.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier for the intake mapping.

type [required]

enum

Type identifier for AWS cloud authentication intake mapping. Allowed enum values: aws_cloud_auth_intake_mapping

data [required]

[object]

List of GitHub cloud authentication intake mappings.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes for GitHub cloud authentication intake mapping response.

claim_matchers [required]

object

GitHub Actions OIDC claims to match against. Each field is a regular expression. The sub claim is required; all other claims are optional. A token matches only when all provided patterns match simultaneously (AND semantics).

actor

string

Regular expression matched against the actor claim.

actor_id

string

Regular expression matched against the actor_id claim.

enterprise

string

Regular expression matched against the enterprise claim.

enterprise_id

string

Regular expression matched against the enterprise_id claim.

environment

string

Regular expression matched against the environment claim.

event_name

string

Regular expression matched against the event_name claim.

job_workflow_ref

string

Regular expression matched against the job_workflow_ref claim.

ref

string

Regular expression matched against the ref claim.

ref_type

string

Regular expression matched against the ref_type claim.

repository

string

Regular expression matched against the repository claim.

repository_id

string

Regular expression matched against the repository_id claim.

repository_owner

string

Regular expression matched against the repository_owner claim.

repository_owner_id

string

Regular expression matched against the repository_owner_id claim.

repository_visibility

string

Regular expression matched against the repository_visibility claim.

runner_environment

string

Regular expression matched against the runner_environment claim.

sub [required]

string

Regular expression matched against the entire sub (subject) claim, the primary GitHub Actions OIDC identifier (for example, repo:<OWNER>/<REPO>:ref:refs/heads/main). The pattern must begin with repo:<OWNER>/, where <OWNER> is a literal repository-owner name rather than a regular expression.

workflow

string

Regular expression matched against the workflow claim.

workflow_ref

string

Regular expression matched against the workflow_ref claim.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier for the intake mapping.

type [required]

enum

Type identifier for GitHub cloud authentication intake mapping. Allowed enum values: github_oidc_auth_intake_mapping
